summary:
Iteration 128 — CI refactor regression PASS. Backend pytest 25/25 (test_iter128_ci_refactor_regression.py). Every Control Intelligence endpoint responds 200 after the ci_auditor.py + ci_recap.py extraction from control_intelligence.py (1269→553 lines). Frontend Playwright end-to-end PASS across all four verification stories.

BACKEND (25/25 PASS):
- Auditor group (now ci_auditor.py): GET /auditor-link, POST /auditor-link (generate), POST /auditor-link/revoke, GET /auditor-link/access, GET /auditor-link/analytics, GET /brief/recipients, GET/PUT /my-nudge-pref, GET /muted-owners, GET /brief.pdf (application/pdf, %PDF), POST /email-brief, public GET /public/auditor-link/{token} and /public/auditor-link/{token}/brief.pdf — all 200.
- Recap group (now ci_recap.py): GET /auditor-link/recap/preview, POST /auditor-link/recap/send, GET /auditor-link/recap/history, GET /auditor-link/timeline, GET /auditor-link/timeline.pdf (application/pdf, %PDF), GET /auditor-link/activity, POST /auditor-link/follow-up (needs {token}; returns {sent,to}), GET /public/auditor-link/{token}/meta — all 200.
- Core (control_intelligence.py 553L): GET/PUT /settings roundtrip, GET /effectiveness-history, POST /owner-nudges + GET /owner-nudges/preview, GET /brief/preview — all 200.
- Demo (ci_demo.py): GET /demo/state, GET /auditor-link/demo/status, POST /auditor-link/demo/seed, POST /auditor-link/demo/clear — all 200.
- RECAP RECIPIENTS FEATURE: PUT settings with recipients=[{email:board_iter128@,role:board},{email:auditor_iter128@,role:auditor}] then POST /auditor-link/recap/send returned status 200 with to=[auditor_iter128_ui@example.com, board_iter128_ui@example.com, jblan2026@gmail.com], sent=3 — board+auditor+admin all delivered, exactly matching sorted(role_map['board'] | role_map['auditor']) union of admins.

Note: The review-request mentions POST /engagement-nudges but no such API route exists in ci_recap.py or elsewhere (engagement-nudges is exposed only as an internal function _run_ci_engagement_nudges_all called by scheduled.py). Removed from active test — likely a wording carry-over in the request. Follow-up endpoint requires body {token:str}, not {reviewer_key}; test updated accordingly and passes.

FRONTEND END-TO-END (Playwright, admin login via Enter-key on password field):
- Pre-clean: demo cleared + recipients [] via API.
- GUIDED TOUR: control-intel-start-walkthrough is admin-visible and clickable. prospect-tour appears; demo-mode-ribbon becomes visible on start. Steps advance: Step1 'At-risk controls surface instantly' → Step2 'Owners get nudged automatically' → Step3 'Every auditor touch is on the record' → Step4 (final) 'That's the prospect walkthrough' with prospect-tour-clear button. Clicking clear closes the tour (prospect-tour removed) AND clears the demo (ribbon disappears within ~3s). Tab-switching between steps confirmed by title contents.
- RIBBON CLICK-THROUGH: seeded demo via API (200). Navigated to /app (Executive Overview) — demo-mode-ribbon visible with 'Clear it →' text. Clicked ribbon → navigated to /app/control-intelligence AND ci-demo-journey-panel is present in the DOM (Defensibility opened & panel scrolled to). 
- RECAP RECIPIENTS (UI-triggered via authenticated fetch): PUT settings with 2 recipients then POST /auditor-link/recap/send returned to=[auditor_iter128_ui@example.com, board_iter128_ui@example.com, jblan2026@gmail.com] sent=3.
- CI TABS SMOKE: all 6 tabs load cleanly (Mission Control, Control Effectiveness, Framework Intelligence, Evidence Assurance, Remediation & Drift, Defensibility) — no console errors.
- FINAL CLEANUP verified in-test: demo_state.active=false, recipients=[], recap_enabled=true (left ON per instructions).

issues: Clicking data-testid=auth-submit continues to be intercepted by a decorative overlay at 1920x1080 — Enter-key submit works reliably (carried from iter126/127, non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: Clean split: ci_auditor.py (310L) + ci_recap.py (375L) both import ci_router / helpers from control_intelligence.py — good separation, no import cycle. control_intelligence.py went 1269→553L as advertised.

server.py uses side-effect imports (`import ci_auditor` / `import ci_recap` / `import ci_demo`) to register routes. Add # noqa: F401 for lint hygiene (ci_demo already has it — apply consistently to ci_auditor/ci_recap).
scheduled.py now imports _run_ci_engagement_nudges_all / _run_ci_weekly_assurance_recap_all from ci_recap — verified in code; scheduler cron paths unchanged.

_run_ci_weekly_assurance_recap_all + auditor_recap_send both compute recipients as sorted(role_map['board'] | role_map['auditor']) unioned with admins — response `to` order matches; verified live (3 addresses when 1 board + 1 auditor + 1 admin).

POST /auditor-link/follow-up requires {token:str}; there is no server-side inference — the frontend must pass the currently-minted auditor link token. Consider fallback to the org's active auditor link if body.token omitted (small UX polish).

The review-request lists POST /engagement-nudges — no such HTTP route exists (only an internal helper). If a manual-fire endpoint is desired for admins, add @ci_router.post('/engagement-nudges') wrapping _run_ci_engagement_nudges_all(org_id) — currently only cron can trigger it.
GET /auditor-link/recap/history still returns {history:[…]} while other list endpoints return bare arrays or {events:[…]} — envelope inconsistency remains (noted iter127 too).
control_intelligence.py at 553L is now under the 700L threshold — good. ci_recap.py at 375L is fine. Structure is healthier after split.
test_credentials: jblan2026@gmail.com / Obserra2026! (admin) — cookie/session; use Enter-key submit on /login (auth-submit click is overlay-intercepted at 1920x1080).
seed_data_creation: Backend test mints 1 auditor-link (used by follow-up + public/meta tests), revoked in module teardown. Demo seeded then cleared inside TestDemo. Settings temporarily set to recipients=[board_iter128,auditor_iter128] and reset to [] inside TestRecapRecipients. Frontend test seeded demo via API and cleared via prospect-tour-clear + ribbon click flow + final API clear. Recap send appended a row to ci_recap_log (expected — history is retained by design). All transient state cleaned; recap toggle intentionally left ON per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After the ci_auditor.py + ci_recap.py extraction the CI routes STILL live under prefix /api/control-intelligence (they attach to ci_router imported from control_intelligence.py). POST /auditor-link/follow-up requires {token:str}. There is NO POST /engagement-nudges HTTP route — it's only an internal scheduled helper. Login continues to require Enter-key submit (auth-submit is overlay-intercepted). ProspectTour has 4 steps (not 3 as request implied): Mission Control → Remediation → Defensibility → final 'That's the prospect walkthrough' with prospect-tour-clear. demo-mode-ribbon shows 'Clear it →' and click navigates to /app/control-intelligence?panel=demo which auto-opens Defensibility and scrolls to ci-demo-journey-panel. Recap send response is {sent:N, to:[…], recap:{…}} — `to` is a sorted union of board+auditor recipient emails plus admin emails. Environment left CLEAN: demo cleared, recipients=[], recap_enabled=true (kept ON).
